derivation: exact RingHom.toMonoidHom_injective (universalMulHom_unique (RingHom.toMonoidHom f) fS hf (↑φ) huniv)
explanation: The multiplicative-hom uniqueness theorem gives equality of the underlying monoid homomorphisms for the same localization data. Applying injectivity of `RingHom.toMonoidHom` yields the stated equality of ring homomorphisms; the theorem's current proof does exactly this.
